capabilities.purpose: Collect and validate reviewed bootstrap inputs for initialization, adoption, or upgrade.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: May write only a specifically requested setup-session artifact outside the target project.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Inspection needs no mutation authority; an external session write requires an explicit output path and grants no project authority.
limitations: Does not apply a transaction, accept a decision, run project hooks, or grant runtime permission.

capabilities.purpose: Initialize a new empty project with an Octon Mini harness and dossier.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Read-only planning followed by a digest-bound empty-target transaction.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Apply requires an explicit profile, reviewed plan digest, unchanged inputs, and repository-local implementation authority.
limitations: Never overwrites an existing path and does not establish harness adoption or project readiness.

capabilities.purpose: Add an Octon Mini baseline to an established project without replacing project-owned authority.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Read-only semantic proposal and planning followed by a reviewed no-overwrite local transaction.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Apply requires explicit dispositions for collisions and functional equivalents plus the exact reviewed digest.
limitations: Leaves adoption in progress and never treats structural installation as accepted authority or readiness.

capabilities.purpose: Plan or apply a deliberate Octon Mini migration, including a reviewed cross-brand transition from a legacy snapshot.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Three-way, digest-bound local migration with exact rollback evidence.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Apply requires reviewed classifications, preserved project authority, exact current preimages, and the accepted migration digest.
limitations: Legacy launcher material is inert migration input only and is never executed or retained as runtime compatibility.

capabilities.purpose: Inspect a project and propose bootstrap archetype, hook, and setup inputs.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Local inspection only; hosted observation requires separate authority outside this command.
limitations: Proposals are non-authorizing and do not configure the target.

capabilities.purpose: Run read-only structural, contract, lifecycle, and integrity validation for a generated project.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: None; bytecode and cache writes are suppressed and project hooks are not executed.
limitations: Structural success does not prove adoption, implementation quality, specialist approval, release readiness, or production readiness.

capabilities.purpose: Diagnose integrity and recovery problems and propose bounded derived repairs.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: A separately selected repair may write only reviewed derived paths through a digest-bound transaction.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Diagnosis is read-only; repair requires explicit selection and the exact reviewed digest.
limitations: Cannot repair project-owned authority, substantive evidence, decisions, credentials, or external state.

capabilities.purpose: Start, block, close, reopen, hand off, or resume governed project work.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Lifecycle changes use reviewed local plan/apply transactions; resume is read-only.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Mutations require explicit task semantics, existing authority references, satisfied lifecycle gates, and the exact reviewed digest.
limitations: Task records describe and constrain work but do not authorize external effects.

capabilities.purpose: Plan and resume governed Git and provider work completion for an adopted small-team workflow.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Planning is read-only; apply and resume use monotonic receipts for explicitly authorized local and external effects.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Every external operation requires current task-scoped authorization bound to the reviewed digest and revalidated live preconditions.
limitations: Source mode uses an external immutable Codex-task reference and creates no second task lifecycle.
External effects are resumable rather than atomically reversible; self-review never becomes peer approval.

capabilities.purpose: Govern one external worker through bounded context, validated progress, measurable limits, committed checkpoints, and deterministic resumption.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Dormant dispatch when absent; an explicitly installed and adopted package writes only package-owned run state while task effects remain in existing transaction or work-completion boundaries.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires an installed content-addressed package, explicit project adoption, an existing task authority basis, exact path narrowing, current bindings, and current validation.
limitations: Does not host a model, create task scope, grant permission, or replay an ambiguous effect.

capabilities.purpose: Discover, assess, preview, activate, and govern bounded autonomous delivery for an already human-prioritized task.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Research, context, assessment, planning, status, explanation, and activation preview are read-only before activation; write-capable behavior requires the exact independently confirmed standing contract and locally bundled package activation.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: A profile or draft grants nothing; every mutation or external effect requires a current exact standing-authorization record, independent confirmation evidence, exact-plan coverage, current limits, and live revalidation.
limitations: No direct spending, credential handling, deployment, package publication, communication, external-project control, force operation, or ambiguous-effect replay.

capabilities.purpose: Maintain explicit project dossier artifact registrations and their reviewed metadata.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Proposal, review, and digest-bound repository-local transaction.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires explicit registry choices, preserved stable IDs, and the exact reviewed digest.
limitations: Does not infer applicability, ownership, review, evidence, or authority.

capabilities.purpose: Configure explicit target-project check hooks and their declared effect contracts.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires project-owned hook configuration, an assigned owner, direct argv, effect declarations, and the reviewed digest.
limitations: Configuration does not authorize hook execution; checks run only through the separate evidence writer.

capabilities.purpose: Assess project collaboration topology and maintain a reviewed project-owned classification.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Assessment is read-only; an explicit reviewed transaction may update project-owned aggregate configuration.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires current privacy-minimized evidence and an accepted project decision only when a workflow is adopted.
limitations: Does not grant access, count bots as humans, select assurance, or adopt a workflow by recommendation.

capabilities.purpose: Plan or install a pinned Octon Mini capability package after explicit trigger assessment.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires applicability, owner, accepted trust decision, exact package version and digest, and reviewed transaction digest.
limitations: Package presence cannot grant authority or prove an external provider, control, scanner, or service exists.

capabilities.purpose: Regenerate declared project-local derived catalogs, state, manifests, and integrity outputs.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Explicit derived-only writer with staged validation.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires explicit invocation and may write only paths declared by the project refresh contract.
limitations: Does not rewrite source records, infer facts, run project hooks, or create readiness evidence.

capabilities.purpose: Plan compatible reversible local bundles and apply reviewed staged repository-local transactions against exact current preimages.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Compatible bundle planning plus staged digest-bound apply with pending journal and exact receipt.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires the exact reviewed digest, unchanged instructions and preimages, and authority for the declared local mutation.
limitations: There is no force mode and no transaction may manufacture project or external authority.

capabilities.purpose: Restore exact recorded preimages for an unchanged applied repository-local transaction.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Receipt-bound exact local restore with resumable rollback state.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires an exact receipt and paths that still match the recorded post-apply state.
limitations: Refuses independent changes and cannot roll back external effects atomically.

capabilities.purpose: Recover or finalize an interrupted reviewed repository-local transaction.
capabilities.mutation_behavior: Pending-journal recovery limited to exact preimage or planned-postimage states.
capabilities.authorization_boundary: Requires the recorded pending journal and exact path-state agreement.
limitations: Ambiguous or independently changed paths fail closed; recovery does not create new authority.
